models.label: ECMWF IFS 0.25°
models.note: ECMWF's operational physics model, open-data release. Its gust field is a maximum over the output interval, not an instantaneous value, so gust factors look large in light air.

models.label: ECMWF AIFS
models.note: ECMWF's machine-learning model - a genuinely independent opinion. Publishes no gust field, so gusts come from IFS and ICON-2i only.

models.label: ItaliaMeteo ICON-2i
models.note: ItaliaMeteo / ARPAE high-resolution model for Italy - the finest grid available here. Runs only ~60-72 h ahead and updates every 12 h, so it drops out of the longer-range view.

models.label: Météo-France MFWAM
models.note: Full sea-state decomposition - total wave, wind wave and swell with heights, directions and periods.

models.label: ECMWF WAM 0.25°
models.note: Total significant wave height only - used to cross-check MFWAM.

briefing.headline: Light SE air and near-flat seas through tomorrow - Stromboli to Panarea is an easy 11 nm, best off the buoy by 06:00.
briefing.synopsis: The payload carries no pressure analysis, so I won't characterise the synoptic pattern beyond what the model winds show: a light easterly to southeasterly flow across the archipelago, 2-6 kt overnight building to 6-8 kt by midday Monday (consensus of ECMWF IFS 0.25°, ECMWF AIFS and ICON-2i, all 05 Oct 12Z). Direction backs to SSE late Monday - Panarea reads 8.4 kt SSE with gusts to 17.5 kt at 00:00 Tuesday. Into Tuesday the flow eases further and goes variable, with ICON-2i dropping out of range beyond roughly 72 h. Seas stay minimal: MFWAM (05 Oct 00Z) and ECMWF WAM (05 Oct 12Z) agree on 0.1-1.1 ft total wave anywhere in the group through Wednesday.
briefing.overnight_anchorage: No berth scorecard is published for tonight's Stromboli mooring in this payload - only hourly conditions - so treat this as indicative. Those hourly values are as benign as it gets: 1.9 kt from the E with gusts to 4.9 kt and 0.1 ft wave at midnight, rising only to 3.0 kt SE, gusts 5.2 kt, 0.3 ft at 06:00 (multi-model consensus, 05 Oct 12Z runs). Nothing in the numbers would push the fleet to shift berths before dawn; the usual Stromboli caveat is that the roadstead is open and any onshore slop is felt rather than forecast at 25 km resolution.
briefing.tomorrow_morning: Monday opens light and flat - the 06:00 window for Stromboli to Panarea shows 4.8 kt SE, gusts 7.6 kt, 0.3 ft sea, 86° TWA for a beam reach, computed verdict go. Wind builds gently through the day to about 7.4 kt ESE with gusts to 13.6 kt at midday, still 0.3 ft, so every window 06:00 to 14:00 is rated go; 06:00 is simply the quietest water. Expect to motor or motor-sail the 11 nm at these speeds.

passage_notes.note: All windows 06:00-14:00 rated go. 4.8-7.4 kt SE-ESE, gusts 7.6-13.6 kt, 0.3 ft wave, beam to broad reach. Recommended departure 06:00; no deterioration flagged.

Go across the day. 5-7 kt S to ESE, 0.9-1.0 ft wave, broad reach after 08:00. ECMWF IFS shows gusts to 19 kt against a 7 kt mean mid-morning - that is an interval-maximum in light air, reported not flagged. Recommended departure 06:00; at 5-7 kt plan on engine time for 28 nm.
Go, but a motoring leg: 3.8-6.0 kt ESE on the nose (TWA 13-26°), gusts to 13.0 kt, 0.7-0.8 ft wave. Recommended departure 06:00.

Go for the 06:00 and 08:00 starts - 9.9-11.8 kt SW to W, gusts 15.4-21.0 kt, 1.0-1.2 ft. The 10:00 window is computed no-go on thunderstorms in the passage window; 12:00 and 14:00 return to go at 8.8-9.2 kt WSW with wave building to 2.3 ft. Forecast deteriorates after 09:00.

cautions: Thunderstorms are in the model for the Salina-Portorosa passage window around 10:00 Thursday - that is the single convective signal anywhere in this payload and it is four days out.

Models disagree on wind speed at several hours Tuesday: Portorosa 12:00 shows a 0.7-7.7 kt spread and 18:00 a 0.6-9.4 kt spread; Lipari 00:00 Tuesday 1.9-9.3 kt and 18:00 2.4-9.3 kt; Stromboli 18:00 Tuesday 4.1-10.3 kt. Treat the consensus means at those hours as uncertain.

ECMWF IFS gust figures are interval maxima, not instantaneous - hence gust-to-mean ratios near 3:1 in light air (e.g. 19.2 kt over a 6.7 kt mean on the Filicudi leg). Expect less on deck than the number suggests.
Portorosa Marina on Thursday night shows 6.3 kt WSW but a 26.8 kt gust figure in the same column - worth watching as that run updates, even in an enclosed basin.
MFWAM is the oldest input here at 22.9 hours (05 Oct 00Z); cross-check against ECMWF WAM before relying on the sea-state detail.
briefing.confidence_note: At 0-24 h lead the last runs have shifted by only 0.2-0.6 kt mean (max 1.4 kt), so tomorrow's leg is solid; beyond 48 h the spread widens to 1.5-1.9 kt mean with direction shifts of 32-40°, which is why Thursday is sketched rather than settled.

verification.measures: forecast stability, not verified accuracy - the reference is the newest model run for the same hour, not an observation
